notes: Search & Destroy: one life per round, attackers plant a bomb at the map's centre site (hold F for 4 s), defenders defuse (6 s), 40 s fuse, 90 s to plant, teams swap roles every round, first to 6. Site marker, planted bomb with blinking light and accelerating beep, explosion. Round and bomb timers, plant/defuse prompts and progress on the HUD. Spectate: dead players in team modes follow living teammates over the shoulder after the killcam (click or Space to switch).
